rows.name: regexp-capture-50
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<50} {incr i} {regexp {^ADD ([a-z]+) ([0-9]+)$} {ADD tea 42} m name amount;incr total $amount};list $total $name

rows.name: regexp-start-50
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<50} {incr i} {incr total [regexp -start 3 -all {a} {abaabaaba}]};set total

rows.name: regsub-capture-50
rows.source: set text [string repeat {tea=12 coffee=34 } 25];regsub -all {([a-z]+)=([0-9]+)} $text {\2:\1} output;string length $output

rows.name: regexp-about-20
rows.source: set result {};for {set i 0} {$i<20} {incr i} {set result [regexp -about {^([a-z]+)=([0-9]+)$}]};set result

scope: Six small warm-session regexp/regsub workloads, native and Node measured separately on one host; exact results verified. Different host adapters; no full application, peak memory or cross-platform acceptance.
